title: One-Day Cricket Reaches 5000 Matches
summary: One-day international cricket has become the first format to reach 5000 matches. India has played the most matches, while Australia leads in terms of wins. Sachin Tendulkar is among the top run-scorers. Recently, Rashid Khan achieved a unique record in ODI cricket, becoming the first spinner to accomplish this feat. Afghanistan won the second match of the ODI series, with Khan's performance being a major highlight.
summary_points: One-day international cricket has reached 5000 matches.
India has played the most one-day international matches.
Australia leads in terms of wins in one-day international cricket.
Sachin Tendulkar is among the top run-scorers in one-day international cricket.
Rashid Khan became the first spinner to achieve a unique record in ODI cricket.
